name: Prepare a board decision brief
why: An evidence map, a board update and a review rhythm from company facts, matching the board and investor update skill.

name: Quarterly strategy reviewer
why: Keeps, cuts or changes last quarter's goals and sets dated results for the next, like the quarterly planning workflow.

name: Objectives and key results writer
why: A quick first draft of objectives with dated, numbered key results before the OKR skill checks baselines and owners.

name: Big decisions first sorter
why: Sorts a messy plan's open questions so the few hard decisions get a brief, as in the ten-to-three prompt.

name: Decision checklist keeper
why: Records each big decision and how it turned out, the same habit as the decision log.

name: Weekly meeting actions keeper
why: Minutes, last week's open actions and the next agenda, for the weekly leadership meeting.

name: Executive work follow up agent
why: Tracks changed commitments and drafts follow-ups from the leader's notes, for the weekly rhythm.

name: Monthly roles and goals reviewer
why: Checks where the leader's month actually went against their goals, a useful input to the monthly review.

name: Plan a week that puts what matters first
why: Turns the quarter's priorities into a protected week, with a Friday review.

name: Prepare a small team offsite
why: A decision-first agenda, pre-read request and action register for a planning day.

name: Set team goals, run one-on-ones and settle decisions
why: Goals with key results, a one-on-one plan and a way to settle disputes, for leaders setting up their first rhythm.

name: Annual letter writer
why: A plain yearly letter to the team or owners with honest numbers, the long form of the investor update.

name: Bold bet downside checker
why: Puts numbers on the worst case of a one-way-door decision before the brief recommends it.
